published_ranges._min_nozzle: 0.6mm nozzle with 0.2-0.3mm layer height recommended by vendor
published_ranges._notes: Vendor: 'Extruder: 230-250°C (Hotter to get better layer adhesion)'; 'Slow print speed down if you are having trouble with filament feeding'. Semi-flex 100A is harder than Bambu TPU 95A HF; parent is closest available, not confirmed. Vendor says it suits bowden extruders; AMS use not stated by vendor. 2.85mm version exists (sold by authorised resellers). Density not published for 100A (the 98A data sheet's 1.22 is a different grade and is not used). Colours not captured.
